cases.name: read-winget-no-effect-parameter
cases.note: A long option the table does not list only uses CustomParameters.

cases.name: read-winget-interactive-long
cases.note: '--interactive' would ask for Interactive, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-interactive-long-any-case
cases.note: '--INTERACTIVE' would ask for Interactive, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Long options match ignoring ASCII case. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-interactive-short
cases.note: '-i' would ask for Interactive, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-interactive-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-interactive-short-wrong-case
cases.note: Short options match with their exact characters.

cases.name: read-winget-interactive-granted
cases.note: '--interactive' would ask for Interactive, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). A grant of Interactive does not make it readable. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-long-option-prefix
cases.note: No abbreviation: 'interact' is not in the table.

cases.name: read-winget-long-option-text-before-equals
cases.note: '--interactive=yes' would ask for Interactive, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). The long option's name is its text before the first '='. Control: read-winget-long-option-prefix.

cases.name: read-winget-triple-hyphen
cases.note: Names the long option '-interactive'.

cases.name: read-winget-single-hyphen
cases.note: '-' has no other character, so it names no option.

cases.name: read-winget-ignore-security-hash
cases.note: '--ignore-security-hash' would ask for SkipHashCheck, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-force
cases.note: '--force' would ask for SkipHashCheck, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-force-any-case
cases.note: '--Force' would ask for SkipHashCheck, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-no-upgrade
cases.note: '--no-upgrade' would ask for NoUpgrade, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-uninstall-previous
cases.note: '--uninstall-previous' would ask for UninstallPrevious, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-override
cases.note: '--override' would ask for InstallerArguments, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-short-o-not-listed.

cases.name: read-winget-custom
cases.note: '--custom' would ask for InstallerArguments, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-short-o-not-listed.

cases.name: read-winget-override-attached
cases.note: '--override=/quiet' would ask for InstallerArguments, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-short-o-not-listed.

cases.name: read-winget-override-value-not-option
cases.note: '--architecture' takes the next element '-i' as its value, even though it starts with '-', so '-i' names no option and the request stays readable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-attached-value-frees-next.

cases.name: read-winget-attached-value-frees-next
cases.note: With an attached value, '--architecture=x64' does not take the next element, so '-i' names Interactive and the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-override-value-not-option.

cases.name: read-winget-override-missing-value
cases.note: '--override' would ask for InstallerArguments, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). An option that takes no value still has its effect. Control: read-winget-short-o-not-listed.

cases.name: read-winget-short-o-not-listed
cases.note: '--override' has no short form in the table.

cases.name: read-winget-cluster-names-each
cases.note: '-ei' would ask for Interactive, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). '-ei' names '-e' and '-i'. Control: read-winget-cluster-unlisted.

cases.name: read-winget-cluster-other-order
cases.note: '-ie' would ask for Interactive, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). '-ie' names '-i' and '-e'. Control: read-winget-cluster-unlisted.

cases.name: read-winget-terminator-before
cases.note: No element after '--' names an option.

cases.name: read-winget-terminator-after
cases.note: '--interactive' would ask for Interactive, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). The '--' after it does not undo it. Control: read-winget-terminator-before.

cases.name: read-winget-location
cases.note: '--location' would ask for CustomInstallLocation, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-location-after-terminator.

cases.name: read-winget-location-short
cases.note: '-l' would ask for CustomInstallLocation, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-location-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-location-short-wrong-case
cases.note: '-L' is not '-l', since short options match with their exact characters, so it asks for no opt-in and the request is readable. Control: read-winget-location-short.

cases.name: read-winget-location-long-any-case
cases.note: '--LOCATION' would ask for CustomInstallLocation, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Long options match ignoring ASCII case. Control: read-winget-location-after-terminator.

cases.name: read-winget-location-attached
cases.note: '--location=C:\Apps' would ask for CustomInstallLocation, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-location-after-terminator.

cases.name: read-winget-location-short-attached
cases.note: '-l=C:\Apps' would ask for CustomInstallLocation, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-location-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-location-in-cluster
cases.note: '-el' names '-e' and '-l'; '-l' takes no value there but still has its effect and would ask for CustomInstallLocation, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-cluster-unlisted.

cases.name: read-winget-location-after-terminator
cases.note: No element after '--' names an option, so '--location' asks for nothing and the request is readable. Control: read-winget-location.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-machine
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Elevated, because a Machine scope without Scope is unreadable with NonElevated (§reading).

cases.name: read-winget-scope-user
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-value-any-case
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Elevated, because a Machine scope without Scope is unreadable with NonElevated (§reading).

cases.name: read-winget-scope-option-any-case
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-attached
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Elevated, because a Machine scope without Scope is unreadable with NonElevated (§reading).

cases.name: read-winget-scope-other-value
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Elevated, because a scope a custom parameter makes unknown is unreadable with NonElevated (§reading).

cases.name: read-winget-scope-missing-value
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Elevated, because a scope a custom parameter makes unknown is unreadable with NonElevated (§reading).

cases.name: read-winget-scope-attached-empty
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Elevated, because a scope a custom parameter makes unknown is unreadable with NonElevated (§reading).

cases.name: read-winget-scope-not-set
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-terminator-stops-second
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Elevated, because a Machine scope without Scope is unreadable with NonElevated (§reading).

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-long
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-short
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-value-any-case
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-neutral-attached
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-short-attached
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-other-value
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-missing-value
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-in-cluster
cases.note: '-a' is not the only short option of '-ea', so it takes no value and makes the architecture unknown; 'x64' is a separate element. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all.

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-in-cluster-attached
cases.note: '-a' is not the only short option of '-ea=x64', so it takes no value and makes the architecture unknown. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all.

cases.name: read-winget-architecture-short-wrong-case
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-winget-version-long
cases.note: --version makes the version unknown and not concrete, even beside Package.Version (§missing-version).

cases.name: read-winget-version-missing-value
cases.note: The option still has its effect without a value.

cases.name: read-winget-version-short-wrong-case
cases.note: '-V' is not in the table.

cases.name: read-winget-version-uninstall
cases.note: An uninstall is never missing its version.

cases.name: read-winget-override-value-terminator
cases.note: '--architecture' takes the next element '--' as its value, so that '--' does not end the options and '-i' names Interactive: the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-winget-terminator-before-short.

cases.name: read-winget-source-long
cases.note: '--source' changes the source, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-source-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-source-short
cases.note: '-s' changes the source, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-source-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-source-any-case
cases.note: '--SOURCE', a long option matched ignoring ASCII case, changes the source, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-source-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-source-attached
cases.note: '--source=msstore' changes the source, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-source-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-source-in-cluster
cases.note: '-es' names '-e' and '-s'; '-s' takes no value there but still has its effect, and changes the source, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-source-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-manifest-long
cases.note: '--manifest' changes the source, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-source-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-manifest-short
cases.note: '-m' changes the source, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-source-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-source-uninstall
cases.note: '--source' changes the source on an Uninstall too, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-source-short-wrong-case.

cases.name: read-winget-source-short-wrong-case
cases.note: '-S' is not '-s', since short options match with their exact characters, so the request is readable.

cases.name: read-winget-manifest-short-wrong-case
cases.note: '-M' is not '-m', since short options match with their exact characters. Control: read-winget-manifest-short.

cases.name: read-winget-source-after-terminator
cases.note: No element after '--' names an option, so '--source' changes nothing. Control: read-winget-source-long.

cases.name: read-winget-source-as-option-value
cases.note: '--architecture' takes the next element '--source' as its value, so '--source' names no option. Control: read-winget-source-long.

cases.name: read-winget-interactive-opt-in
cases.note: OptIns.Interactive makes the request use Interactive, which the policy does not grant. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-append-ungranted
cases.note: WinGet accepts installer arguments; OptIns.InstallerArguments with Mode Append makes the request use InstallerArguments, which the policy does not grant. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-append-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-append-granted
cases.note: WinGet accepts installer arguments with Mode Append, and the policy grants InstallerArguments.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-ungranted
cases.note: WinGet accepts installer arguments; OptIns.InstallerArguments with Mode Replace makes the request use InstallerArguments, which the policy does not grant. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted
cases.note: WinGet accepts installer arguments with Mode Replace, and the policy grants InstallerArguments.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-uninstall-ungranted
cases.note: On an Uninstall the broker passes neither '--custom' nor '--override', and the request still uses InstallerArguments (§manager-winget, §reading). Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-uninstall-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-uninstall-granted
cases.note: A WinGet Uninstall with OptIns.InstallerArguments is readable, and the policy grants InstallerArguments.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-not-custom-parameter
cases.note: The Arguments '--interactive' are not a custom parameter: the broker passes them as the value of '--override', so they ask for no other opt-in. Control: read-winget-interactive-long.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-batch-quote
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains the batch character ", so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-batch-percent
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains the batch character %, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-batch-exclamation
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains the batch character !, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-batch-caret
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains the batch character ^, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-batch-ampersand
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains the batch character &, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-batch-pipe
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains the batch character |, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-batch-less-than
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains the batch character <, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-batch-greater-than
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains the batch character >, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-replace-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-batch-uninstall
cases.note: A batch character in OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments makes the request unreadable whatever its operation, though an Uninstall does not pass the arguments. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-uninstall-granted.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-nul
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains U+0000, which the broker cannot pass to a manager. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-tab.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-line-feed
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains U+000A, which the broker cannot pass to a manager. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-tab.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-carriage-return
cases.note: OptIns.InstallerArguments.Arguments contains U+000D, which the broker cannot pass to a manager. Control: read-winget-installer-arguments-tab.

cases.name: read-winget-installer-arguments-tab
cases.note: U+0009 is not one of U+0000, U+000A, U+000D, and not a batch character.

cases.name: read-winget-custom-parameter-batch-quote
cases.note: A custom parameter contains the batch character ", so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-custom-parameter-batch-percent
cases.note: A custom parameter contains the batch character %, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-custom-parameter-batch-exclamation
cases.note: A custom parameter contains the batch character !, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-custom-parameter-batch-caret
cases.note: A custom parameter contains the batch character ^, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-custom-parameter-batch-ampersand
cases.note: A custom parameter contains the batch character &, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-custom-parameter-batch-pipe
cases.note: A custom parameter contains the batch character |, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-custom-parameter-batch-less-than
cases.note: A custom parameter contains the batch character <, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-custom-parameter-batch-greater-than
cases.note: A custom parameter contains the batch character >, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-no-effect-parameter.

cases.name: read-winget-location-batch-quote
cases.note: OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path contains the batch character ", so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-location-plain-path.

cases.name: read-winget-location-batch-percent
cases.note: OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path contains the batch character %, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-location-plain-path.

cases.name: read-winget-location-batch-exclamation
cases.note: OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path contains the batch character !, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-location-plain-path.

cases.name: read-winget-location-batch-caret
cases.note: OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path contains the batch character ^, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-location-plain-path.

cases.name: read-winget-location-batch-ampersand
cases.note: OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path contains the batch character &, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-location-plain-path.

cases.name: read-winget-location-batch-pipe
cases.note: OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path contains the batch character |, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-location-plain-path.

cases.name: read-winget-location-batch-less-than
cases.note: OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path contains the batch character <, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-location-plain-path.

cases.name: read-winget-location-batch-greater-than
cases.note: OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path contains the batch character >, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-location-plain-path.

cases.name: read-winget-location-plain-path
cases.note: A plain local path through WinGet, granted by the policy.

cases.name: read-winget-id-batch-percent
cases.note: Package.Id contains the batch character %, the only one the request allows in an identifier, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-request-plain.

cases.name: read-winget-source-name-space-inside
cases.note: 'my source' is a plain source name: a space inside is allowed (§managers, §manager-winget).

cases.name: read-winget-source-name-punctuation
cases.note: 'my.src-1_x' is a plain source name: '.', '-' and '_' are allowed (§managers, §manager-winget).

cases.name: read-winget-source-name-leading-digit
cases.note: '1src' is a plain source name: it may start with a digit (§managers, §manager-winget).

cases.name: read-winget-source-name-leading-dot
cases.note: '.src' is not a plain source name: it starts with '.', so the request is unreadable (§managers, §manager-winget). Control: read-winget-source-name-punctuation.

cases.name: read-winget-source-name-leading-underscore
cases.note: '_src' is not a plain source name: it starts with '_', so the request is unreadable (§managers, §manager-winget). Control: read-winget-source-name-punctuation.

cases.name: read-winget-source-name-slash
cases.note: 'src/x' is not a plain source name: it contains '/', so the request is unreadable (§managers, §manager-winget). Control: read-winget-source-name-punctuation.

cases.name: read-winget-source-name-at-sign
cases.note: 'src@x' is not a plain source name: it contains '@', so the request is unreadable (§managers, §manager-winget). Control: read-winget-source-name-punctuation.

cases.name: read-winget-source-name-non-ascii
cases.note: 'wingét' is not a plain source name: it contains a non-ASCII letter, so the request is unreadable (§managers, §manager-winget). Control: read-winget-source-name-punctuation.

cases.name: read-winget-source-name-not-plain-uninstall
cases.note: The WinGet plain source name rule applies whatever the operation. Control: read-winget-source-name-punctuation.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-machine-nonelevated-install
cases.note: '--scope machine' makes the scope Machine while Scope is absent and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable whatever its operation. Control: read-winget-scope-machine.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-unknown-nonelevated-install
cases.note: '--scope global' makes the scope unknown, and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable whatever its operation. Control: read-winget-scope-other-value, which is Elevated.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-machine-nonelevated-update
cases.note: '--scope machine' makes the scope Machine while Scope is absent and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable whatever its operation. Control: read-winget-scope-machine-elevated-update.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-machine-elevated-update
cases.note: '--scope machine' with Elevation Elevated is readable.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-unknown-nonelevated-update
cases.note: '--scope global' makes the scope unknown, and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable whatever its operation. Control: read-winget-scope-other-value, which is Elevated.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-machine-nonelevated-uninstall
cases.note: '--scope machine' makes the scope Machine while Scope is absent and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable whatever its operation. Control: read-winget-scope-machine-elevated-uninstall.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-machine-elevated-uninstall
cases.note: '--scope machine' with Elevation Elevated is readable.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-unknown-nonelevated-uninstall
cases.note: '--scope global' makes the scope unknown, and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable whatever its operation. Control: read-winget-scope-other-value, which is Elevated.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-missing-value-nonelevated
cases.note: '--scope' without a value makes the scope unknown, and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-scope-missing-value, which is Elevated.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-twice-nonelevated
cases.note: A scope set twice is unknown, even to the same value, and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-request-scope-two-parameters-same, which is Elevated.

cases.name: read-winget-scope-user-field-machine-parameter-nonelevated
cases.note: Scope User and '--scope machine' set the scope twice, so it is unknown, and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-scope-user.

cases.name: read-winget-non-ascii-option-name
cases.note: '--\u0131nteractive' has U+0131 LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I in its option name, a code point above U+007F, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-ascii-unlisted-option.

cases.name: read-winget-ascii-unlisted-option
cases.note: '--xnteractive' has only ASCII in its option name and names no option in the WinGet table, so the request is readable.

cases.name: read-winget-non-ascii-after-equals
cases.note: The option name ends at the first '=', so U+00E9 after it is not in the option name and the request is readable. Contrast read-winget-non-ascii-option-name.

cases.name: read-winget-non-ascii-not-option
cases.note: 'caf\u00e9' does not start with '-', so it has no option name and the request is readable. Contrast read-winget-non-ascii-option-name.

cases.name: read-winget-dependency-source
cases.note: '--dependency-source' changes the source dependencies come from, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-dependency-sources-not-listed.

cases.name: read-winget-dependency-source-any-case
cases.note: '--DEPENDENCY-SOURCE' is '--dependency-source' ignoring ASCII case, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-dependency-sources-not-listed.

cases.name: read-winget-dependency-source-attached
cases.note: '--dependency-source=msstore' takes its value after '=', so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-dependency-sources-not-listed.

cases.name: read-winget-dependency-source-uninstall
cases.note: The '--dependency-source' row names no operation and applies to an Uninstall, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-dependency-sources-not-listed.

cases.name: read-winget-dependency-sources-not-listed
cases.note: '--dependency-sources' is a longer name, not '--dependency-source', so the request is readable.

cases.name: read-winget-all-update
cases.note: '--all' on an Update upgrades every installed package that has an update, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-all-install.

cases.name: read-winget-recurse-update
cases.note: '--recurse' on an Update upgrades every installed package that has an update, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-recurse-install.

cases.name: read-winget-short-r-update
cases.note: '-r' on an Update upgrades every installed package that has an update, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-short-r-install.

cases.name: read-winget-cluster-r-update
cases.note: '-er' names '-e' and '-r', and '-r' is refused on an Update, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-short-r-wrong-case-update.

cases.name: read-winget-all-any-case-update
cases.note: '--ALL' is '--all' ignoring ASCII case, so the request is unreadable. Control: read-winget-all-install.

cases.name: read-winget-short-r-wrong-case-update
cases.note: '-R' is not '-r', because a short option matches with its exact characters, so the request is readable.

cases.name: read-winget-all-install
cases.note: The '--all' row applies only to an Update, so the request is readable.

cases.name: read-winget-recurse-install
cases.note: The '--recurse' row applies only to an Update, so the request is readable.

cases.name: read-winget-short-r-install
cases.note: The '-r' row applies only to an Update, so the request is readable.

cases.name: read-winget-all-uninstall
cases.note: The '--all' row applies only to an Update, so the request is readable.
